mostWorthwhile.text: Using the spindle on the copied DNA was most worthwhile: the time-strip connects chromosome separation to two complete daughter nuclei while showing that the cell has not yet split.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing and then using the membrane supply were straightforward, largely goal-directed steps, though the ER-to-Golgi picture plan gave them context.

surprise.text: The spindle was presented as a preview rather than an already assembled structure; its timing caption clarified that assembly occurs during mitosis after DNA copying.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the broad item title “New cell proteins” did not itself explain which proteins would form spindle fibres; the result introduced tubulin.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the daughter cells become different tissues, especially after the final picture plan points toward lining, muscle and nerve cells.
